description: Feed performance and video playback stability: (1) Ensure video posts do NOT attempt autoplay (expo-av is NOT installed and must NOT be added), (2) Video posts should display a thumbnail/image fallback with a play icon overlay indicating video content, (3) Optimize FlatList performance with proper memoization
steps: Step 1: Update mobile/src/components/home/PostCard.tsx to detect video posts (using getPrimaryVideo from utils/media.ts). When a post has video media, display the image thumbnail (getPrimaryImageUrl) with a play icon overlay (using Ionicons 'play-circle' icon) to indicate the post contains video. Do NOT import expo-av or any video player.
Step 2: Wrap PostCard component with React.memo() to prevent unnecessary re-renders during scroll. The comparison should use post._id.

Step 3: In mobile/src/screens/home/HomeScreen.tsx, add performance optimizations to FlatList: add getItemLayout if feasible (or removeClippedSubviews={true}), maxToRenderPerBatch={5}, windowSize={5}, initialNumToRender={5}. These prevent frame drops during fast scrolling.
Step 4: Verify that the mobile TypeScript compiles without errors.
acceptance_criteria: PostCard shows a play icon overlay for video posts without importing or using expo-av
PostCard is wrapped in React.memo for scroll performance
FlatList has performance props (removeClippedSubviews, maxToRenderPerBatch, windowSize)
expo-av is NOT added to package.json
verification: Verify expo-av is NOT in mobile/package.json
Read PostCard.tsx and confirm React.memo wrapper and video overlay logic
findings: The custom react type stubs in mobile/types/react/index.d.ts did not include React.memo. Added the memo type declaration to the stub file. TypeScript check passes with the same 35 pre-existing errors (none from modified files). Review fix: React.memo comparator expanded to also compare isLikedByMe and isSavedByMe. renderItem wrapped in useCallback.
